text: And two escorts are already at your door. Early, of course.
One in white. One in black. One very heavy chain.
Forget the lake of fire. Chinese hell is a government office.
Ten courts. Eighteen floors. No elevator.
A mirror replays every lie you ever told. Yes. That one too.
Serve your time. Cross the last bridge.
Grandma hands you soup. One sip, and you forget everything. Even your passwords.
